title: PRISM: Pushing the Frontier of Deep Think via Process Reward Model-Guided Inference
abstract: arXiv:2603.02479v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: DEEPTHINK methods improve reasoning by generating, refining, and aggregating populations of candidate solutions, which enables strong performance on complex mathematical and scientific tasks. However, existing frameworks can still suffer from unreliable correctness signals during inference, which creates a population- enhancement bottleneck where deeper deliberation amplifies errors, suppresses correct minority solutions, and yields weak returns to additional compute. In this paper, we introduce a functional decomposition of DEEPTHINK systems and propose PRISM, a Process Reward Model (PRM)-guided inference algorithm that uses step-level verification to guide resampling, proposal acceptance, and solution aggregation. During refinement, PRISM uses PRM scores to guide population resampling and stochastic local refinement, which concentrates computation on higher-quality reasoning while preserving diversity. translated_title: PRISM：通过过程奖励模型引导推理突破深度思考的极限
translated_abstract: 深度思考方法通过生成、细化和聚合候选解种群来提升推理能力，从而在复杂数学和科学任务上取得强大性能。然而，现有框架在推理过程中仍可能受到不可靠正确性信号的影响，这造成了种群增强瓶颈：更深入的推敲会放大错误、抑制正确的少数解，并使额外计算带来的收益微弱。本文对深度思考系统进行了功能分解，并提出了PRISM——一种由过程奖励模型（PRM）引导的推理算法，它利用步骤级验证来指导重采样、提案接受和解方案聚合。在细化阶段，PRISM利用PRM分数引导种群重采样和随机局部细化，将计算集中在更高质量的推理上，同时保持多样性。当与PRM分数验证相结合时（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出PRISM算法，利用过程奖励模型（PRM）的步骤级验证来引导深度思考中的重采样、提案接受与解方案聚合，解决了因正确性信号不可靠导致的种群增强瓶颈问题。
en_tdlr: PRISM is a Process Reward Model-guided inference algorithm that leverages step-level verification to guide resampling, proposal acceptance, and solution aggregation in DeepThink, overcoming the population-enhancement bottleneck caused by unreliable correctness signals.
